```{r}
install.packages('SurrogateRank', repos = c('https://laylaparast.r-universe.dev', 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
```

```{r}
library(SurrogateRank)
library(ranger)
```

```{r}

#Load in objects from Female PreProcessing File

files <- list.files("FemalePreProcessing/", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

for (f in files) {
  obj_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  assign(obj_name, readRDS(f))
}

```


```{r}
riseresfemale <- rise.screen(
  yonefemalemix, #numeric vector of primary response values in the treated group (antibody values at Day 28)
  yzerofemalemix, #numeric vector of primary response values in the untreated group (antibody values at Day 0)
  sonefemale, #matrix or dataframe of surrogate candidates in the treated group with dimension n1 x p            where n1 is the number of treated samples and p the number of candidates. Sample ordering          must match exactly yone. (participant id x day 1 gene values)
  szerofemale, #matrix or dataframe of surrogate candidates in the untreated group with dimension n0 x p           where n0 is the number of untreated samples and p the number of candidates. Sample                 ordering must match exactly yzero. (participant id x day 0 gene values)
  alpha = 0.05,
  epsilon = 0.25,
  u.y.hyp = NULL,
  p.correction = "BH",
  n.cores = 1,
  alternative = "two.sided",
  paired = TRUE,
  return.all.screen = TRUE,
  return.all.weights = FALSE,
  weight.mode = "inverse.delta",
  normalise.weights = T
)

```


```{r}
riseresfemalesig <- riseresfemale$significant.markers


saveRDS(riseresfemalesig, "riseresfemalesig.rds")

#5716 significant markers
```

```{r}
#Random Forest

#Cross Validated Random Forest Model using 280 genes as input + plot observed vs. predicted values
#Narrow data frame to 2004 columns i.e genes that improved the Base Model
ageandpart <- BaseModel_Female_Long %>% filter(Visit == 28) %>% select(condres, participant_id)

improvegenematrix<- merge_studytime1_female - merge_studytime0_female

rfgenematrix <- improvegenematrix[,unlist(riseresfemalesig)] # only grabbing improved genes for this matrix

rfgenematrix$participant_id <- row.names(rfgenematrix)

rfgenematrix<- rfgenematrix %>% left_join(ageandpart, by= 'participant_id')  %>% 
  relocate(participant_id, condres) %>% select(-participant_id)
# Use existing fold assignments 1-10
```



```{r}

#Random Forest - RISE

set.seed(123)
k      <- 10
n      <- nrow(rfgenematrix)
p <- ncol(rfgenematrix) -1 
folds    <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))
rffoldout   <- data.frame()
rfpredictions <- numeric(n)

for (i in 1:k) {
  
  train_idx <- which(folds != i)
  test_idx  <- which(folds == i)

  train_data <- rfgenematrix[train_idx,] # Using same training folds as Base Model
  test_data  <- rfgenematrix[test_idx, ] # Using same testing folds as Base Model

  
  # Create mlr task from training fold
  task <- makeRegrTask(data = train_data, target = "condres")
  
  # Tune hyperparameters on training fold only
  tuned <- tuneRanger(
    task,
    measure        = list(mlr::rmse),
    num.trees      = 100,
    num.threads    = 1,
    iters          = 30,
    save.file.path = NULL
  )
  
  # Extract best parameters
  best_mtry       <- tuned$recommended.pars$mtry
  best_nodesize   <- tuned$recommended.pars$min.node.size
  best_samplefrac <- tuned$recommended.pars$sample.fraction
  
  # Fit final model with tuned parameters
  fit <- ranger(
    condres ~ .,
    data            = train_data,
    mtry            = best_mtry,
    min.node.size   = best_nodesize,
    sample.fraction = best_samplefrac,
    num.trees       = 500,
    importance      = "impurity"
  )
  
  # Predict on test fold
  rfpredictions[test_idx] <- predict(fit, data = test_data)$predictions
  
  # Compute fold level metrics
  ss_res   <- sum((rfgenematrix$condres[test_idx] - rfpredictions[test_idx])^2)
  ss_tot   <- sum((rfgenematrix$condres[test_idx] - mean(rfgenematrix$condres[train_idx]))^2)
  rsquared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((rfpredictions[test_idx] - rfgenematrix$condres[test_idx])^2))
  sd_y <- sd(rfgenematrix$condres)
  srmse <- rmse/ sd_y

  rffoldout <- rbind(rffoldout, data.frame(
    fold            = i,
    mtry            = best_mtry,
    min.node.size   = best_nodesize,
    sample.fraction = best_samplefrac,
    srmse             = srmse,
    rsquared        = rsquared
  ))
  
  cat(sprintf("Fold %d | mtry=%d, nodesize=%d, samplefrac=%.2f | R2=%.3f\n",
              i, best_mtry, best_nodesize, best_samplefrac, rsquared))
}

# Overall metrics across all observations
ss_res_total <- sum((rfgenematrix$condres - rfpredictions)^2)
ss_tot_total <- sum((rfgenematrix$condres - mean(rfgenematrix$condres))^2)
overall_r2   <- 1 - (ss_res_total / ss_tot_total)
overall_rmse  <- sqrt(mean((rfgenematrix$condres - rfpredictions)^2))
sd_y <- sd(rfgenematrix$condres)
overall_srmse <- overall_rmse/ sd_y


cat(sprintf("\nOverall R2: %.3f | Overall sRMSE: %.3f\n", overall_r2, overall_srmse))

# View per fold tuning results
print(rffoldout)
```



```{r}
# Build a dataframe of observed vs predicted
rf_results <- data.frame(
  observed  = rfgenematrix$condres,
  predicted = rfpredictions
)

# Compute R²
r2 <- cor(rf_results$observed, rf_results$predicted)^2

# Evaluate with RMSE (correct metric for continuous outcome)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((rfpredictions - rf_results$observed)^2)) # Should this be callign from test data or Base Model

## Standardised RMSE (RMSE divided by standard deviation of response)
sd_y <- sd(rf_results$observed)
std_rmse_rg <- rmse/ sd_y
print(paste("sRMSE:", round(std_rmse_rg, 4)))

# Plot
rffemaleresplot <- ggplot(rf_results, aes(x = observed, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -4,
    y = 1,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    label = paste0(
      "R² = ", round(r2, 3),
      "\nsRMSE = ", round(std_rmse_rg, 3)
    )
  ) +
  xlim(-5, 5) +
  ylim(-2, 2) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    x     = "Observed Mixed Model Residual",
    y     = "Predicted Mixed Model Residual",
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted Residuals (Mixed Linear Model-Female): Random Forest"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

rffemaleresplot
```

```{r}
engenematrix <- rfgenematrix %>% select(-condres)

```

```{r}
# Elastic Net - RISE 

set.seed(123)
k <- 10
n <- nrow(engenematrix)
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))

results   <- data.frame()
y <- rfgenematrix$condres
all_preds <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = length(seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)))  # ADD THIS
a_idx <- 0                                                              # ADD THIS

for (a in seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) {
  a_idx <- a_idx + 1                                                    # ADD THIS
  enpredictions <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 1:k) {
    train_idx <- which(folds != i)
    test_idx  <- which(folds == i)
    x.train <- engenematrix[train_idx, ]
    x.test  <- engenematrix[test_idx, ]
    y.train <- y[train_idx]
    y.test  <- y[test_idx]
    train_scaled <- scale(x.train)
    x.train      <- as.matrix(train_scaled)
    x.test       <- as.matrix(scale(x.test,
                      center = attr(train_scaled, "scaled:center"),
                      scale  = attr(train_scaled, "scaled:scale")))
    fit <- cv.glmnet(x.train, y.train,
                     type.measure = "mse",
                     alpha        = a,
                     family       = "gaussian")
    enpredictions[test_idx] <- predict(fit, s = fit$lambda.min, newx = x.test)
  }
  
  all_preds[, a_idx] <- enpredictions                                   # ADD THIS
  
  ss_res   <- sum((y - enpredictions)^2)
  ss_tot   <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  rsquared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
  rmse     <- sqrt(mean((y - enpredictions)^2))
  sd_y     <- sd(y)
  srmse    <- rmse / sd_y
  
  temp <- data.frame(alpha = a, srmse = srmse, rsquared = rsquared)
  results <- rbind(results, temp)
}

best_idx <- which.max(results$rsquared)                       # ADD THIS
enpredictions_best <- all_preds[, best_idx]                             # ADD THIS
results[best_idx, ]
```
